summary: Bound retained-stop reads to their diagnostic, fault and recovery records.

schema.detail: Adds partial indexes for retained-stop diagnostics and faults, plus a recovery-reference index. Existing rows are indexed when the store opens. No claim schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The same faults and canonical receipts are selected; unrelated diagnostic history no longer increases the SQL work of a deferral miss or a terminal-seat page. Retention and process-stop behavior are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Restart the daemon to install the indexes. Existing-row index creation time has not been measured on a production store.

recovery.detail: Rollback can leave the extra indexes in place; older readers remain compatible.
